<parameter=code>
import collections
grid0 = history[0].frame.ascii.split('\n')
W0=set(); GR=set()
for n in history[0].frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
    tl=(min(rows),min(cols))
    if n['color']=='W': W0.add(tl)
    if n['color']=='g': GR.add(tl)
GREEN=(45,45)
nodes = W0 | {(15,15)} | {GREEN}
def bridge(a,b):
    if a[0]==b[0]:
        return (a[0], min(a[1],b[1])+3) in GR
    if a[1]==b[1]:
        return (min(a[0],b[0])+3, a[1]) in GR
    return False
adj={}
for a in nodes:
    for b in nodes:
        if a!=b and (abs(a[0]-b[0])==6 or abs(a[1]-b[1])==6) and bridge(a,b):
            adj.setdefault(a,set()).add(b)
start=(27,27)
q=collections.deque([(start,[start])]); seen={start}; sol=None
while q:
    st,path=q.popleft()
    if st==GREEN: sol=path; break
    for nb in sorted(adj.get(st,[])):
        if nb not in seen:
            seen.add(nb); q.append((nb,path+[nb]))
def act(a,b):
    if b[0]>a[0]: return 'DOWN'
    if b[0]<a[0]: return 'UP'
    if b[1]>a[1]: return 'RIGHT'
    return 'LEFT'
seq=[act(sol[i],sol[i+1]) for i in range(len(sol)-1)]
print("path:", sol)
print("seq:", seq)
# execute all but last hop, verify, then final hop
res = action(seq[:-1])
grid = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
blue=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if grid[r][c]=='b']
rows=[x[0] for x in blue]; cols=[x[1] for x in blue]
print("player now:", (min(rows),min(cols)))
if (min(rows),min(cols))==(39,45):
    res = action(['DOWN'])
    grid = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    blue=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if grid[r][c]=='b']
    green=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if grid[r][c]=='N']
    print("after final DOWN, blue:", min(blue) if blue else None, "green:", min(green) if green else None)
    print({k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
